name: Modern Spawns
description: Redistributes every wild encounter table across Gen 1-9 species, dynamically, in Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Silver, Crystal, FireRed, LeafGreen, Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald: each map keeps the game's own rates, slot levels, odds, and only the species are re-picked by level, terrain, habitat, type and rarity. Settings in OPTIONS > MODS > Modern Spawns: on/off, a generation cap, SEEDED / EVERY MAP / RANDOM rosters, rare legendaries, and a per-save seed. Published through mod.exports as a framework other mods can build on. Works on the game's own Pokemon alone; a species mod widens the pool: national_dex (NATIONAL DEX option ON) on Red/Blue/Yellow, national_dex_gen3 on FireRed to Emerald. COMPLETE mode (the default) makes every species catchable.
